name: sover
goal:
NORTH STAR (baked into every Sover iteration, heavily weighted): Every social account is run by an autonomous executive whose standing goal is ALWAYS more followers, more engagement, and monetization — pursued creatively and autonomously, with money-out the only human-gated step. A FRESH profile boots as the SIMPLEST possible thing: a chat-only "social-media executive" (the existing POST /sover/chat SSE surface) that talks to the operator to learn the brand, reads live state, and can do exactly three verbs — trigger onboarding, file a proposal, and scaffold its first capability. From there it EXPANDS ITSELF: the executive and the supervisor walk a capability dependency tree (RESEARCH -> COMPOSE -> RENDER -> MEASURE -> MONETIZE), and at each cadence the supervisor proposes the single highest-leverage UNLOCKED node — scored by how much it shrinks "days to the next follower/engagement/monetization milestone" — and scaffolds it via the already-built-but-uncalled capabilities.scaffold() loop. The profile literally grows new routes, lanes, and panels INTO itself over time; if a capability cannot be done yet, the agent BUILDS it by authoring a new capability node from vetted templates rather than editing frozen core.

ABSOLUTE CONSTRAINT — REUSE, DON'T REINVENT: The discovery/approval/rebuild spine is 100% shipped and inert (capabilities.scaffold/decide, api/app.py:109 routers_for, lane_runner.py:315 + sover_supervisor.py:163 + standalone.py:137 lane_specs merges, rebuild_relaunch_exe.py, the X-Operator-Confirm + proposals.py + monetization_gate ledger gates). Sover's job each iteration is to connect a CALLER and a PLANNER to that loaded loop — never to build a new agent runtime, approval system, or rebuild path. Self-modification stays additive and human-approved; frozen core stays frozen; every dollar crosses a human's desk. Simplicity-first is binding: anything beyond a prompt action-parser, a genesis route, honest docs, a template-based scaffolder, and a tree-walking planner is gold-plating to be rejected.

LIVE DEPLOYMENT CONTEXT — GAINS.GOD.GROWTH: Sover is now running live as the autonomous social-media executive for the Gains.God.Growth brand (faith + discipline + gym motivation) across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. The GGG profile uses the free OpenRouter model nex-agi/nex-n2-pro:free for all LLM roles (creative, brain, chat). The operator has set auto_post=true and publish_platforms includes all three platforms. Content voice: raw, masculine, encouraging, NEVER cynical; faith-and-iron. Short punchy quotes for 10-second reels, 2-4 lines each. Hashtag mix: #gains #god #growth #faith #discipline #gymmotivation (core) plus a pool of fitness/christian/strength tags. 3 posts/day, best hours 6AM/12PM/6PM/9PM, cross-posted to all 3 platforms.

ITERATE FROM MISTAKES: Each Solomon RSI iteration MUST read the Sover agent's recent run logs (.runtime/ggg/pi_runner_heartbeat.json, data/ggg/strategy.json, lane_state.json, the CGO's markdown briefs) and identify MISTAKES the agent made — silent lane failures, off-brand content, missed posting windows, broken browser automation, poor hashtag selection, content that didn't perform, voice drift, reward-hacking, capability scaffolds that don't actually work. The iteration's improvement should FIX the highest-leverage mistake found, making the agent better at autonomously expanding GGG on the next run. The loop's fitness signal is: did the fix make Sover post more, post better, or grow the accounts faster? A fix that prevents a recurring silent failure is worth more than a cosmetic improvement. Prioritize: (1) content quality and on-brand-ness, (2) posting reliability and throughput, (3) platform automation robustness (browser_harness, CDP, DOM selectors), (4) analytics accuracy, (5) capability tree progression. The goal does not shrink to fit budget — a truthful null (no mistake found worth fixing this cycle) beats a fabricated improvement.

name: asmodeus
goal: ASMODEUS NORTH STAR (heavily weighted every iteration): Asmodeus is a live-capable algorithmic trading system whose Layer-2 'strategy builder' LLM must actually produce VALIDATED, PROFITABLE strategy candidates that advance through the anti-overfit funnel toward live. RIGHT NOW THE SECOND LAYER IS BROKEN: the layer2_builder tool registry is mis-wired so every builder tool call fails — observed in builder_*.log as: evaluate_batch() missing 1 required positional argument: 'bars'; backtest() missing 1 required positional argument: 'bars'; backtest() raised 'dict' object has no attribute 'timeframe'; rule_significance() raised 'NoneType' object is not iterable. As a result 0 candidates advance despite ~10M tokens burned. HIGHEST-LEVERAGE FIX FIRST: repair the tool-call wiring in asmodeus/layer2_builder/tools.py and its dispatch from asmodeus/workers/builder_lane.py so the builder's backtest / evaluate_batch / optimize / monte_carlo / rule_significance tools receive the market `bars` and a proper timeframe object, the tool loop runs end-to-end, and candidates actually advance. VERIFY with the pytest gate AND by confirming builder_*.log shows successful tool calls and at least one advancing candidate before claiming success. THEN iterate on strategy quality so the system generates genuinely profitable, statistically-significant strategies. ITERATE FROM MISTAKES: each cycle read the most recent builder_*.log / meta_loop.log errors and fix the highest-leverage failure. A truthful null beats a fabricated 'already done' — never claim a fix you did not write and verify.

name: dotz
gate: npm run typecheck && npm run check
goal: Improve dotz — a pi.dev-based, Claude-Desktop-style coding-agent dashboard (embedded pi SDK + Fastify backend on 127.0.0.1:4317 + vanilla-JS cyberbrutalist UI, packaged as an Electron .exe). Make additive, high-leverage improvements: fix real bugs, harden the Fastify/WebSocket server and Electron lifecycle, improve agent/session reliability, error handling, and operator UX. Keep every change green under the gate (npm run typecheck = tsc --noEmit, and npm run check = the no-console-window guard — all child processes MUST stay windowless). Do NOT introduce new heavy dependencies or architectural layers; simplicity-first. Strengthen test/verification coverage where cheap. A truthful null beats a fabricated improvement — never claim an edit you did not write.
